question: Can zero-initialized feed-forward biases improve the remaining residual generalization failures across both teachers?
motivation: At decay 0.1, learned-even-zero reaches 15/24 (odd 12/12, mixed 3/12), while shifted reaches 9/24. All 24 selected-arm training scores meet the unchanged threshold. In the complete 144-checkpoint reflection diagnosis, mixed-teacher held-out odd and even errors both remain substantial (means 0.048040 and 0.047239 under one symmetric-probe normalization). A bias could help represent offsets and shifted features; that hypothesis is not established by the diagnosis.
single_change: Add deterministic zero-initialized trainable FFN bias vectors, with two separate new arms: output projection bias only; or both gate/value hidden biases and output projection bias. Implement explicit additions around the same original bias-free linear modules. Preserve all original parameters and their RNG draws. Keep the existing even coefficient initialization, scalar residual gates, pre/post RMS and scaling.
added_parameters: For depth D, width d=16 and hidden h=43: output adds D*d; all adds D*(2*h+d). There is no new matrix or RNG draw. Explicitly report the capacity increase; do not call this a parameter-matched architecture comparison.
unchanged_protocol: Both fixed sphere-input teachers; depths 4/16, strengths 0.25/1, seeds 0/1/2; dimension16/hidden43; train512 and heldout512, data seed1; batch64, full512updates even after crossing, cadence32, warmup16; native AdamW betas0.9/0.98, epsilon1e-8 and weight decay0.1 on every parameter including biases; initial matrix std0.1. First held-out relativeMSE<=0.05 is success. CPU FP32 highest, one thread. No augmentation or altered target/threshold/budget.
controls: Reuse all48 decay0.1 cells from the completed decay study, including its failures. Keep all previous controls, weight-decay regressions, activation/initialization and numerical studies unchanged.
selection: Require the full exact144-cell grid. Rank each of six activation/bias configurations on all24 cells across both teachers by pooled threshold coverage, then geometric-mean first-crossing updates only with all24 successes; otherwise worst final held-out relativeMSE, median as tie-break. Report every paired seed, every miss and each teacher separately. No teacher-specific selection or successful-only mean.
validation: Before training verify identical original matrices/RNG, exact initial function with zero biases including nonzero residual gates, declared added capacity, independent biased activation forward/backward equations and unchanged training loop/optimizer/data/batch protocol. Archive committed source and validation before training. Audit every new checkpoint by replaying full train/heldout scores, histories, crossings, optimizer steps/settings/state and sampler state.
mathematical_scope: The existing finite-epsilon RMS output norm and post-RMS residual radius bounds still apply to any biased raw branch output. Trained biases can break input oddness, so do not carry over a bias-free oddness claim. No new whole-network Jacobian, generalization or convergence theorem follows from adding biases.
source_policy: A new sibling package; copy the exact existing parity training loop with an explicit new model constructor and honest initialization/capacity metadata. Preserve every completed scientific Python file and plan. Put post-run audits outside the frozen package.
scope: Adaptive synthetic residual follow-up, independent of the running inverse-width attention benchmark. It does not modify the full GPT or use any early99 long-suite outcome.
